summary: Small ball caster assembly with a steel ball held in a ball holder at the bottom. Four standoff posts rise from a square mounting base plate with a corner hole at each corner. The kit can be built at a 25 mm or 35 mm height. This model uses the 35 mm configuration.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat square base plate with four corner screw holes, used to fasten the caster to a chassis.

notes: Height of 35 mm is stated in the text and drawing (25 mm alternative also available). The footprint of about 25 x 25 mm is estimated from the photo by comparing the plate width with the height and from typical hardware proportions; it is not printed. Hole diameter of about 3 mm and the hole positions are estimates based on the 3 mm screws shown in the instructions (3x10 mm tapping screws and 3 mm nuts). The top of the posts also shows holes, but their positions and depth are not given, so they are not listed. The ball diameter is not stated.
